name: foldling_fish
notes: Floats: belly 1 cm above the table; the origin stays on the table top.

name: paper_bird
notes: Flying form after a correct answer. Origin at the body centre; flies towards +x.

name: flag_small
notes: Origin at the foot of the pole; attach to a Foldling flag_anchor. Plain cream cloth, the game draws the number at label_anchor.

name: popup_book
notes: Open flat. spawn_anchor: centre of the left page; town_origin: centre of the right page; exit_anchor: 6 cm above the spine. page_hinge_* hold the top leaf (rotate about z to turn a page).

name: popup_book_closed
notes: Spine on the -x side; cover_front opens about z at its spine edge.

name: page_popup_frame
notes: Panels hinge on their bottom edge: rotate about x from -90 (flat) to 0 (upright, rest pose). Place at the back of the open book.
